note: Set A binds every claim to airfoil names that actually appear in the figure legends (SNL-FFA-W3-500, FFA-W3-211/241/270blend/301/330blend/360) and its read-off values (Re numbers, cl/cd peaks and values at given AoA, cd at cl=1.5, cl at AoA=20) are consistent with the plotted curves. Set B invents or misbinds entities that do not exist in the legend — 'FFA-W3-3', 'FFA-W3-2' and 'SNL-FFA' — and attaches roughly eleven claims to them, including contradictory duplicate maxima for 'FFA-W3-3' (120 and 110) and lift/drag values fabricated from axis tick labels. Set A's weakest point is that several cl/cd quotes cite only the legend entry rather than the plotted value, but the values themselves are faithful; Set B's invented-component claims are outright wrong.
